servicios.card1Text: Corporate transport offers efficient solutions for your company's mobility needs. With a focus on punctuality and comfort, our services ensure satisfaction for both your employees and your clients. We have a modern fleet and professional drivers to ensure every trip is safe and comfortable.
servicios.card2Text: Our school transport service is designed with student safety and well-being in mind. With trained drivers and vehicles equipped with the latest safety measures, we offer a reliable solution for transporting students to and from school. Your peace of mind and that of parents is our priority.
servicios.card3Text: Discover fascinating destinations with our tourism transport service. Whether you are planning a group trip or an individual excursion, our team is ready to make your experience unforgettable. With onboard amenities and expert guides, we will take you to explore new places and live exciting adventures.
servicios.feat1Title: Corporate transport: efficiency for your business
servicios.feat1Text: Our corporate transport service offers efficiency and comfort for your company. Optimize your employees' time with safe, punctual transfers. With our modern fleet and professional drivers, we ensure your business trips are productive and worry-free.
servicios.feat2Title: School transport: peace of mind for parents and students
servicios.feat2Text: With our school transport service, we provide peace of mind for parents and safety for students. Parents can trust that their children will arrive at school safely and on time, while students enjoy comfortable, stress-free journeys. Our trained drivers ensure reliable, calm transfers.
servicios.feat3Title: Tourism transport: discover and enjoy without worries
servicios.feat3Text: Explore new destinations and live unforgettable experiences with our tourism transport service. You can relax and enjoy the journey while we take you to fascinating places. Our expert guides will ensure your adventure is safe, comfortable, and full of memorable moments.
servicios.whyText: Our transport services are designed to deliver tangible benefits on every trip. From optimizing work time with corporate transport to providing safety and comfort in school transport and creating memorable tourism experiences, we are committed to making your journeys productive, safe, and pleasant. Trust us for reliable, quality transport.

nosotros.aboutHtml:
Transportes Especiales Maco Tours SAS is a leading Colombian company in public transport. We are proud to offer comprehensive solutions adapted to hard-to-reach areas across the national territory.

With extensive experience, we stand out for successfully tackling challenging projects. Our presence spans all of Colombia, providing public transport services that go beyond conventional routes.

At the heart of our success is a highly qualified, committed team. Every member contributes to service excellence, ensuring efficient, professional operations on every trip.

Our commitment focuses not only on operational efficiency but also on understanding our clients' specific needs. We work closely with you to provide transport solutions tailored to your requirements.

By choosing us, you trust a partner committed to customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. Discover how Maco Tours can facilitate your travel with safety, reliability, and exceptional quality.
nosotros.visionText: At Transportes Especiales Maco Tours SAS, we aspire to be the leading reference in public transport. We envision a future where our company is synonymous with innovation, operational excellence, and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction over the next five years of continuous growth.
nosotros.missionText: At the heart of our mission is the commitment to provide public transport solutions that exceed expectations. We strive to deeply understand our clients' specific needs and continuously adapt to overcome challenges in every project, with relentless focus on efficiency, safety, and quality across Colombia.
nosotros.valuesHtml:
1. Commitment: We commit to exceeding our clients' expectations and maintaining high quality standards in all our operations.

2. Innovation: We embrace innovation to constantly improve, seeking and applying new technologies and practices that enhance our service efficiency.

3. Integrity: We act with honesty and transparency in all our interactions, building relationships based on trust and respect.

4. Collaboration: We foster a collaborative work environment where every team member contributes their unique experience to collective success.
nosotros.iso45001Text: Occupational health and safety management system: we strengthen our commitment to protecting health and safety at work through a solid occupational safety policy.
nosotros.iso14001Text: Environmental management system: we reinforce our commitment to environmental protection through a solid environmental policy.
nosotros.iso9001Text: Quality management system: we reinforce our commitment to quality through a solid quality management policy, demonstrating our focus on excellence in products and services.

equipo.intro: At Transportes Especiales Macotours, we firmly believe in cultivating an organizational culture based on solid values that guide our daily actions and decisions. Our multidisciplinary team shares and promotes the following core values:
equipo.profText: At Macotours, we understand that professionalism goes beyond simply completing assigned tasks. It means maintaining high standards of conduct in everything we do, from how we communicate with clients to how we treat our teammates. We strive to be role models in our industry with an unwavering commitment to excellence.
equipo.collabText: At Macotours, we understand that the best results come when we work together as a unified team. We foster a culture of collaboration where every voice is heard and every contribution is valued. We believe in the power of diverse thinking and experiences.
equipo.safetyText: At Macotours, safety is more than a priority: it is an unwavering commitment. We take very seriously the responsibility of transporting our passengers safely and reliably. We ensure our drivers are trained and certified, our vehicles are well maintained, and our operations meet the strictest safety standards.
equipo.clientText: At Macotours, we understand that our clients are the cornerstone of our business. We are committed to constantly exceeding their expectations, providing exceptional service that not only meets but surpasses their needs. We strive to create memorable, personalized transport experiences.
equipo.innovText: At Macotours, we believe innovation is key to staying at the forefront of our constantly evolving industry. We are committed to constantly seeking new ways to improve and optimize our operations, from cutting-edge technology to new strategies and approaches.
equipo.respectText: At Macotours, we believe diversity is our strength. We value and respect the individual differences of our employees and clients, recognizing that each person brings a unique and valuable perspective to our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and respected.

empresarial.intro: We are pleased that you are considering our corporate transport services to meet your company's mobility needs. Below is a summary of the procedure we follow to ensure efficient, safe service:
empresarial.processIntro: In the corporate transport process, we provide customized mobility solutions to meet your company's specific needs. We begin with an initial consultation to understand your requirements and then:
empresarial.processLi1: Conduct a detailed analysis of available options.
empresarial.processLi2: Negotiate contract terms transparently and fairly.
empresarial.processLi3: Sign a contract that clearly establishes the responsibilities of both parties.
empresarial.processLi5: Provide ongoing follow-up and support to ensure your satisfaction.
empresarial.processLi6: Regularly evaluate the service and seek improvement opportunities.
empresarial.processOutro: Our goal is to provide reliable, efficient corporate transport that contributes to your business success. Contact us for more information or to begin the hiring process.

escolar.intro: We are pleased to offer our school transport service, designed to ensure student safety and comfort on their journey to and from school. Below we detail our school transport process:
escolar.step6: Communication and follow-up with parents and school
escolar.processIntro: In our school transport service, we are committed to providing a safe, reliable environment for students on their journey to and from school. Our process includes the following steps:
escolar.processLi1: We conduct an initial consultation to understand your educational institution's specific needs.
escolar.processLi2: We carry out a detailed analysis of the most suitable routes and schedules for students.
escolar.processLi3: We agree on services and fees that best fit your requirements and budget.
escolar.processLi4: We sign the contract and complete the required documents to formalize the service.
escolar.processLi5: We implement the service according to agreed terms, ensuring punctuality and safety on every trip.
escolar.processLi6: We maintain open, constant communication with parents and the educational institution.
escolar.processLi7: We continuously evaluate our service to identify areas for improvement and ensure the highest quality and safety standards.
escolar.processOutro: Our goal is to provide reliable, quality school transport that gives parents peace of mind and ensures students' punctuality and safety on their way to school.
escolar.regsTitle: Regulations and obligations for school transport
escolar.reg2: Technical and operational conditions in service provision.
escolar.reg4: Obligations of the Ministry of Education and Education Secretariats.
escolar.reg5: Register vehicles with the traffic authority in the jurisdiction where the service is provided.
escolar.reg6: Comply with special markings and requirements established in Decree 1079 of 2015.
escolar.reg7: Have valid contractual and non-contractual civil liability insurance policies.
escolar.reg8: Keep vehicles in optimal mechanical and safety condition.

turistico.intro: We are pleased that you are considering our tourism transport services to explore and enjoy the most fascinating destinations. Below is a summary of the procedure we follow to ensure a memorable, safe experience:
turistico.processIntro: In the tourism transport process, we are dedicated to offering memorable travel experiences so you can fully enjoy your favorite destinations. We begin with an initial exploration to understand your interests and then:
turistico.processLi1: Plan and propose personalized itineraries that match your preferences.
turistico.processLi2: Manage bookings and confirmations efficiently to ensure a smooth experience.
turistico.processLi3: Prepare a detailed itinerary including activities and places to visit during your trip.
turistico.processLi4: Implement the service as planned, ensuring your comfort and safety at all times.
turistico.processLi5: Provide ongoing follow-up and support to ensure your experience is satisfactory.
turistico.processLi6: Regularly evaluate our service and seek ways to improve it for even richer experiences.
turistico.processOutro: Our goal is to provide quality tourism transport that allows you to explore new places and create unforgettable memories. Contact us for more information or to start planning your next trip.
turistico.regsTitle: Regulations and requirements for tourism transport
turistico.reg1: Valid traffic license and/or operating card.
turistico.reg3: Valid technical-mechanical and emissions inspection certificate.
turistico.reg5: Public service vehicle driver's license in categories C1 or C2 as applicable.
turistico.reg7: Driver identity document linked in the FUEC.
turistico.reg8: Valid non-contractual and contractual civil liability policies.

privacidad.intro: At Transportes Maco Tours, we are committed to our users' privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect personal information obtained through our website and other communication channels.
privacidad.collect1: Contact information such as name, email address, and phone number provided through contact forms or newsletter subscriptions.
privacidad.collect2: Payment information such as credit or debit card data provided to process payments for services.
privacidad.collect3: Demographic information such as geographic location that may be collected for analysis and service improvement purposes.
privacidad.noCookies: It is important to note that we do not automatically collect personal information through cookies or other tracking technologies.
privacidad.useIntro: The personal information we collect is used for the following purposes:
privacidad.use1: Respond to user inquiries and requests.
privacidad.use3: Send marketing communications and newsletters if the user has opted in to receive them.
privacidad.use4: Improve our products and services through data analysis and user feedback.
privacidad.discloseIntro: At Transportes Maco Tours, we do not sell, rent, or share personal information with third parties except in the following circumstances:
privacidad.disclose1: When necessary to provide services requested by the user, such as payment processing.
privacidad.disclose2: To comply with legal obligations, such as responding to court orders or government requirements.
privacidad.securityText: At Transportes Maco Tours, we are committed to protecting our users' personal information through appropriate security measures, including physical, electronic, and administrative safeguards to prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, misuse, or alteration of personal information.
privacidad.thirdText: Our website may contain links to third-party websites that are not under our control. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these third-party websites. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies before providing any personal information.
privacidad.changesText: Transportes Maco Tours reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Significant changes will be notified by posting them here. Users are encouraged to review this page periodically to stay informed about how we protect the personal information we collect.
